Its response (press feedback) and sounds like any other membrane. The media control knob, has decent resistance to give feedback when adjusting volume and moves the volume fine enough to get to desired levels without any issues. Backlighting is fair, not a fan of the fixed contrasting colors, but the color choice isn't offensively bright or distracting and the key binds to adjust and control it are easy to understand and perform. Overall a decent membrane keyboard for it's sale price.
